plugins.name: git-governance
plugins.description: Branch-naming taxonomy, commit-message and merge-permission matrix (autonomous up to develop, human-gated for staging/main, per merge or per promotion window), 6 slash commands for the daily solo workflow, a pre-commit config as the primary local validation layer, a quota-conscious GitHub Actions workflow, and a script that configures real GitHub branch protection including per-branch merge methods and automatic work-branch cleanup.
